system.description:
You throw your weapon wrapping it around a target and pulling towards yourself. The target must succeed a Strength saving throw. On a failed save they become Grappled by you. At the end of the affected creatures turns, they can make a Strength saving throw to end the grapple effect on a successful save.

Chain 1: You can target one additional creature in range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the range of this jutsu by +5 feet.
